text: Just to piggyback on what ___ said, ...
meaning: 〜さんの発言に乗っかる形で言うと…
example: Just to piggyback on what Sarah said, the budget is also a concern.
scene: 他の人の意見に補足するとき

meaning: ここで少し口を挟んでもいいですか？
example: Sorry, can I jump in here? I think we're missing one risk.
scene: 議論に割って入りたいとき

meaning: 〜の話に戻りましょう
example: Let's circle back to the pricing question after the demo.
scene: 論点を後で扱う・戻すとき

meaning: この件は会議の外で別途話しましょう
example: This is getting detailed — let's take this offline.
scene: 会議の本筋から外れた議論を切り上げるとき

text: What are the next steps here?
meaning: 次のアクションは何になりますか？
example: Before we wrap up, what are the next steps here?
scene: 会議の締めくくり

text: Just to make sure we're on the same page, ...
meaning: 認識が揃っているか確認させてください…
example: Just to make sure we're on the same page, the deadline is Friday, right?
scene: 合意内容を確認するとき

text: I'll take that as an action item.
meaning: それは私の宿題として引き取ります
example: I'll take that as an action item and follow up by Wednesday.
scene: タスクを引き受けるとき

text: We're running short on time, so ...
meaning: 時間が押しているので…
example: We're running short on time, so let's focus on the top two issues.
scene: 時間管理をするとき

meaning: 〜を順を追って説明してもらえますか？
example: Could you walk me through the numbers on slide five?
scene: 詳しい説明を求めるとき

text: I don't have a strong opinion either way, but ...
meaning: どちらでもこだわりはないのですが…
example: I don't have a strong opinion either way, but option B seems faster.
scene: 軽めに意見を添えるとき

meaning: それをさらに発展させると…
example: To build on that, we could also pilot it in one region first.
scene: 他人のアイデアを発展させるとき

meaning: その件はいったん保留にしましょう
example: Good point, but let's park that for now and revisit next week.
scene: 論点を保留にするとき

text: I see where you're coming from, but ...
meaning: おっしゃる意図はわかりますが…
example: I see where you're coming from, but I think the timeline is too tight.
scene: 相手を尊重しつつ反論するとき

text: I'd push back a little on that.
meaning: その点には少し異論があります
example: I'd push back a little on that — the data suggests otherwise.
scene: 穏やかに反対するとき

meaning: それはもっともな指摘です
example: That's a fair point. I hadn't considered the legal side.
scene: 相手の意見を認めるとき

meaning: 〜という点には完全には納得できていません
example: I'm not entirely convinced that customers will pay for this.
scene: 懐疑的な立場を示すとき

meaning: まったく同感です
example: I couldn't agree more — speed matters more than perfection here.
scene: 強く同意するとき

text: I agree up to a point, but ...
meaning: ある程度までは同意しますが…
example: I agree up to a point, but we still need a backup plan.
scene: 部分的に同意するとき

text: Let me play devil's advocate for a second.
meaning: あえて反対の立場から言わせてください
example: Let me play devil's advocate for a second: what if demand drops?
scene: あえて反論を出して議論を深めるとき

meaning: 〜についてはまだ決めかねています
example: I'm on the fence about hiring an agency.
scene: 判断を保留するとき

text: That makes sense, as long as ...
meaning: 〜である限りは、理にかなっています
example: That makes sense, as long as we keep the client informed.
scene: 条件付きで賛成するとき

text: With respect, I see it a bit differently.
meaning: 失礼ながら、私の見方は少し違います
example: With respect, I see it a bit differently. The risk is in execution.
scene: 目上の人に反論するとき

text: We're on the same page there.
meaning: その点は認識が一致していますね
example: We're on the same page there — quality comes first.
scene: 一致点を確認するとき

meaning: 〜は検討しましたか？
example: Have we considered the impact on existing customers?
scene: 反論を質問の形でやわらかく出すとき

text: As far as I can tell, ...
meaning: 私が把握している限りでは…
example: As far as I can tell, the issue is on the vendor's side.
scene: 確信度を下げて述べるとき

meaning: 〜してみる価値はあるかもしれません
example: It might be worth checking with legal before we sign.
scene: 控えめに提案するとき

meaning: 私としては…と言えると思います
example: I'd say we're about eighty percent done.
scene: 断定を避けて見解を述べるとき

text: Off the top of my head, ...
meaning: ぱっと思いつく限りでは…
example: Off the top of my head, I'd estimate around two weeks.
scene: 準備なしで答えるとき

text: Correct me if I'm wrong, but ...
meaning: 間違っていたら訂正してほしいのですが…
example: Correct me if I'm wrong, but didn't we agree on a fixed fee?
scene: 指摘をやわらかく切り出すとき

meaning: 〜である可能性が高いです
example: There's a good chance that the launch will slip to Q3.
scene: 見込みを伝えるとき

text: I'm not a hundred percent sure, but ...
meaning: 100%確かではないのですが…
example: I'm not a hundred percent sure, but I think the file was updated.
scene: 不確かな情報を共有するとき

meaning: 私には〜のように思えます
example: It seems to me that the real problem is communication.
scene: 主観的な見方として述べるとき

meaning: 大ざっぱに言うと…
example: Roughly speaking, half of our users are on mobile.
scene: 概数・概要を伝えるとき

meaning: どちらかと言えば〜寄りです
example: I'd lean towards the cheaper option for the pilot.
scene: 好みや判断の傾きを示すとき

text: That's not quite what I meant.
meaning: 私の意図とは少し違います
example: That's not quite what I meant — I was talking about the cost, not the scope.
scene: 誤解を訂正するとき

meaning: ある程度は…
example: To some extent, the delay was unavoidable.
scene: 部分的な肯定

meaning: すみません、〜についてもう少し詳しく教えていただけますか？
example: Sorry, could you elaborate on what you mean by 'scalable'?
scene: 詳細を求めるとき

text: When you say ___, do you mean ...?
meaning: 〜とおっしゃるのは、…という意味ですか？
example: When you say 'soon', do you mean this week or this month?
scene: 言葉の意味を確認するとき

meaning: 正しく理解できているか確認させてください…
example: Just so I understand correctly, you want a draft by Monday?
scene: 理解の確認

text: What does success look like for you?
meaning: あなたにとって成功とはどんな状態ですか？
example: Before we start, what does success look like for you?
scene: 期待値・ゴールを確認するとき

text: Who's the main audience for this?
meaning: これの主な想定読者・聞き手は誰ですか？
example: Who's the main audience for this — the board or the sales team?
scene: アウトプットの相手を確認するとき

text: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that.
meaning: すみません、よく聞き取れませんでした
example: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you say it again?
scene: 聞き返すとき

meaning: 〜には融通が利きますか？
example: Is there any flexibility on the deadline?
scene: 条件の幅を探るとき

meaning: この依頼の背景には何がありますか？
example: What's driving this request? Is it coming from the board?
scene: 依頼の背景を探るとき

text: Are there any constraints I should be aware of?
meaning: 把握しておくべき制約はありますか？
example: Are there any constraints I should be aware of, like budget or legal?
scene: 前提条件を確認するとき

text: Could you give me an example?
meaning: 例を挙げていただけますか？
example: Could you give me an example of what you'd like to see?
scene: 具体化を求めるとき

text: Let me rephrase that to check I've got it.
meaning: 理解できたか確認するため、言い換えさせてください
example: Let me rephrase that to check I've got it: you need three options, not one.
scene: 理解の確認

text: How would you like me to prioritize ___?
meaning: 〜の優先順位はどうつけるのがよいですか？
example: How would you like me to prioritize these two tasks?
scene: 優先順位を確認するとき

meaning: 代わりに〜してはどうでしょう？
example: What if we deliver a first version on the 10th instead?
scene: 代案を出すとき

text: We could consider that, provided that ...
meaning: 〜という条件であれば検討できます
example: We could consider that, provided that the scope stays the same.
scene: 条件付きで譲歩するとき

text: That would be difficult for us, because ...
meaning: それは弊社にとって難しいです。なぜなら…
example: That would be difficult for us, because our team is fully booked.
scene: やわらかく断るとき

text: Is there any room to move on ___?
meaning: 〜について譲歩の余地はありますか？
example: Is there any room to move on the price?
scene: 譲歩を探るとき

meaning: 落としどころを見つけましょう
example: Let's find a middle ground — maybe a phased delivery?
scene: 妥協点を探るとき

meaning: その代わりに、〜が必要です
example: In exchange, we'd need faster access to your data team.
scene: 交換条件を出すとき

text: I'm afraid that's a deal-breaker for us.
meaning: 残念ながら、それは弊社にとって譲れない条件です
example: I'm afraid a fixed fee with open scope is a deal-breaker for us.
scene: 譲れない線を示すとき

text: Let me run this by my team and get back to you.
meaning: チームに確認して折り返します
example: Let me run this by my team and get back to you tomorrow.
scene: 即答を避けるとき

meaning: どこなら柔軟に対応できますか？
example: If the date is fixed, where do you have flexibility?
scene: 相手の譲歩可能な点を探るとき

text: From our side, the priority is ___
meaning: 弊社としての優先事項は〜です
example: From our side, the priority is quality, not speed.
scene: 自分側の優先順位を伝えるとき

text: Can we agree on ___ as a starting point?
meaning: まずは〜で合意できますか？
example: Can we agree on the first milestone as a starting point?
scene: 部分合意を取るとき

meaning: もっともなご要望ですが…
example: That's a reasonable ask, but it would push back the testing phase.
scene: 相手を立てつつ難点を伝えるとき

meaning: 〜する予定どおりに進んでいます
example: We're on track to finish the analysis by Friday.
scene: 順調な進捗を報告するとき

meaning: 予定より約〜遅れています
example: We're running about a week behind schedule.
scene: 遅れを報告するとき

text: The main blocker right now is ___
meaning: 現在の主な障害は〜です
example: The main blocker right now is getting access to the sales data.
scene: 障害を報告するとき

text: To get back on track, we plan to ___
meaning: 遅れを取り戻すために、〜する予定です
example: To get back on track, we plan to add one more analyst.
scene: リカバリー策を説明するとき

meaning: 一番のポイントは〜です
example: The key takeaway is that churn is driven by onboarding.
scene: 結論を伝えるとき

meaning: 進捗は随時お知らせします
example: We're still waiting on the vendor, but I'll keep you posted.
scene: 継続報告を約束するとき

meaning: 〜について手短にご報告です
example: Quick update on the pricing study: we've finished the interviews.
scene: 報告の切り出し

meaning: ここまでで〜しました
example: So far, we've interviewed twelve customers.
scene: 完了事項を報告するとき

meaning: 〜について注意喚起しておきたいです
example: I wanted to flag a potential risk with the new supplier.
scene: リスクを早めに共有するとき

meaning: 〜という問題にぶつかりました
example: We ran into some issues with data quality.
scene: 問題発生を報告するとき

meaning: 要するに〜です
example: The bottom line is we need two more weeks.
scene: 結論を端的に述べるとき

meaning: 今後は〜
example: Going forward, I'll send a short update every Friday.
scene: 今後の方針を述べるとき

text: How's your week been so far?
meaning: 今週はここまでどうですか？
example: Hi Sam! How's your week been so far?
scene: 会話の切り出し

text: Did you get up to anything fun over the weekend?
meaning: 週末は何か楽しいことをしましたか？
example: Did you get up to anything fun over the weekend?
scene: 月曜の雑談

text: I've been meaning to ask you ___
meaning: 〜について前から聞こうと思っていたんです
example: I've been meaning to ask you how the move went.
scene: 話題を振るとき

meaning: それはすごくいいですね！
example: You went hiking in Patagonia? That sounds amazing!
scene: 相づち・リアクション

meaning: へえ、それはどうでしたか？
example: You had your big presentation yesterday — oh, how did that go?
scene: 相手の話を広げるとき

meaning: わかります
example: I know what you mean — Mondays are always hectic.
scene: 共感を示すとき

meaning: 〜と言えば…
example: Speaking of food, have you tried the new ramen place?
scene: 話題をつなぐとき

meaning: お久しぶりです！
example: Hey, it's been a while! How have you been?
scene: 再会のあいさつ

meaning: 最近〜にハマっています
example: I'm really into bouldering these days.
scene: 自分の趣味を話すとき

text: Anyway, I should let you go.
meaning: それでは、そろそろ失礼しますね
example: Anyway, I should let you go — the meeting's about to start.
scene: 雑談を切り上げるとき

meaning: まさか！本当に？
example: No way! Really? You met him at the airport?
scene: 驚きを表すとき

text: What do you usually do to unwind?
meaning: 普段はどうやってリラックスしていますか？
example: Work's been intense. What do you usually do to unwind?
scene: 相手のことを聞くとき

meaning: いい質問ですね
example: That's a great question. Let me break it down.
scene: 質問を受けて考える時間を作るとき

text: Let me come back to that in a moment.
meaning: その点は少し後でお答えします
example: Let me come back to that in a moment — it's on the next slide.
scene: 回答を後回しにするとき

meaning: 手短に言えば〜ですが…
example: The short answer is yes, but it depends on the market.
scene: 結論を先に言うとき

meaning: ここでの前提は〜です
example: Our assumption here is that the conversion rate stays at 3%.
scene: 前提を説明するとき

text: I don't have that figure to hand, but I can follow up.
meaning: その数字は手元にありませんが、後ほどご連絡します
example: I don't have that figure to hand, but I can follow up after the meeting.
scene: 答えられない質問への対応

text: If I understand your question correctly, ...
meaning: ご質問を正しく理解していれば…
example: If I understand your question correctly, you're asking about the downside risk.
scene: 質問を確認しながら答えるとき

text: There are two main reasons for this.
meaning: これには主に2つの理由があります
example: There are two main reasons for this. First, ...
scene: 構造立てて答えるとき

meaning: それはもっともな懸念で…
example: That's a valid concern, and we've built in a buffer for it.
scene: 懸念に応えるとき

meaning: 要するに…
example: In a nutshell, we can break even in eighteen months.
scene: 要約するとき

text: The risk we see is ___, and we'd mitigate it by ___
meaning: 想定リスクは〜で、〜によって軽減します
example: The risk we see is low adoption, and we'd mitigate it by partnering with telcos.
scene: リスク対策を説明するとき

meaning: これでお答えになっていますか？
example: So that's how we got to the number. Does that answer your question?
scene: 回答の締め

meaning: イメージしやすく言うと…
example: To put it into perspective, that's about the size of the Tokyo market.
scene: 数字の意味を伝えるとき

meaning: 〜には本当に感謝しています
example: I really appreciate you taking the time to review my draft.
scene: 感謝を伝えるとき

text: One thing I'd like to work on is ___
meaning: 取り組みたいことの一つは〜です
example: One thing I'd like to work on is structuring my updates better.
scene: 自分の改善点を述べるとき

text: Could you give me some feedback on ___?
meaning: 〜についてフィードバックをいただけますか？
example: Could you give me some feedback on how I handled the client call?
scene: FBを求めるとき

meaning: とても参考になります、ありがとうございます
example: That's really helpful, thank you. I'll try that next time.
scene: FBを受け止めるとき

text: Going forward, I'll make sure to ___
meaning: 今後は必ず〜するようにします
example: Going forward, I'll make sure to update stakeholders weekly.
scene: 改善を約束するとき

meaning: 私が〜したら助けになりますか？
example: Would it help if I sent a summary after each meeting?
scene: 改善策を提案するとき

text: I was wondering if we could ___
meaning: 〜できないかと思っていたのですが
example: I was wondering if we could have shorter stand-ups.
scene: 控えめに提案するとき

text: Something that's worked well for me is ___
meaning: 私にとってうまくいったのは〜です
example: Something that's worked well for me is blocking focus time.
scene: 経験を共有するとき

text: I'd love to take on more ___
meaning: もっと〜を担当したいです
example: I'd love to take on more client-facing work.
scene: 希望を伝えるとき

text: Fair enough. I'll keep that in mind.
meaning: 確かにそうですね。心に留めておきます
example: Fair enough. I'll keep that in mind for the next deck.
scene: 指摘を受け入れるとき

text: What would you like me to do differently?
meaning: どう変えてほしいですか？
example: What would you like me to do differently in the next project?
scene: 具体的な期待を聞くとき

meaning: 〜だとありがたいです
example: It would be great if we could get the data a day earlier.
scene: 要望を伝えるとき
